reuse.why: Builds one shared selection (getMonthWideCategories) and iteration helper (forEachMonthWideCategory) that all month-wide actions use, and reuses setNMonthAvg/getCategoryAverage/getSheetValue; the saved-template test is its own goal_def IS NULL condition rather than the template-source fragment used elsewhere in budget/.

duplication.why: Removes the four copied category queries and loops; the only repeat is copyPreviousMonth re-checking `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` that forEachMonthWideCategory already applies.

placement.why: Selection, iteration and the new action live in budget/actions.ts and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts next to the other month-wide methods.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (exclusions, new action, #fixed, includeHiddenCategories) plus tests; the removed getBudgetData became unused.

maintainability.why: One definition decides which categories month-wide actions touch and one flag covers the hidden opt-in, so later rules are a single edit; copyPreviousMonth's separate loop is the one place a maintainer must keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts uses getMonthWideCategories but not forEachMonthWideCategory, re-implementing the income/tracking-budget skip.

disguised_duplication.where: The income skip repeated in copyPreviousMonth is an open repeat of the same condition, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains the includeHidden parameter and the `? = 1 OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0)` branch for step 4 (a legitimate requested variation); copyPreviousMonth bypasses forEachMonthWideCategory and repeats its income rule.
